statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low at 10% while Stress is elevated at 56%; the shared Nasdaq-100 reading applies jointly to NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD.
recommendation: Conditions map to the EA_ON band. The observed overnight price path is two-sided and contained, so Tail remains far below the block threshold even though the macro backdrop - a hawkish Fed repricing, a 4.76% 10-year yield and a Hormuz-driven crude premium - keeps Stress elevated. The narrow danger window spans 13:30-15:00 UTC around the US cash open and the simultaneous 14:00 UTC ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS releases.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures grind to a new overnight high near 29,570 while Hong Kong slides 1% and crude holds above $86 on Hormuz escalation
body: NQ futures trade near 29,542.75, about +0.10%, after extending the overnight band to 29,434.75-29,570.00. The roughly 135-point range has been worked in both directions with repeated rotation and no observed directional efficiency, no shallow-pullback sequence and no repeated extension after failed retracements. E-mini S&P 500 futures are effectively unchanged at 7,699.75 inside an 18-point band. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Monday at 29,456.97, up 0.08%, having recovered from a session low of 29,304.49. VIX sits near 14.92 after a 3.4% rise, low in absolute terms. The macro backdrop is the source of Stress rather than the path. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole address on August 28 was read as hawkish, and futures now price roughly a 57-60% chance of a 25 basis-point hike at the September FOMC, up from about 35% beforehand. The 10-year Treasury yield closed Monday at 4.758%, its highest since January 2025, with the 2-year at 4.34% on the latest H.15 release. Geopolitics adds a second layer: US forces struck Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran retaliated against US bases in Jordan, the first exchange in about a month, lifting WTI to about $86.64 (+1.03%) and Brent to roughly $91.28. Asia is split - the Nikkei 225 closed +0.13% at 66,397.54 while the Hang Seng is down about 1.0% near 25,312 on oil and inflation concerns - and that divergence against a firm NQ is a conflict signal that raises uncertainty rather than Tail. Delayed cross-asset context shows semiconductors uniformly higher in the latest session and megacaps split three-to-five, consistent with dispersion rather than index-level one-way structure. Tail is held at 10% because none of the observed price-path amplifiers are present; Stress is held at 56% for the rates, energy and event stack; Confidence is 88% on current verified levels, yields, oil, volatility and a verified calendar.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment and every one mapped to the EA_ON band. Tail ranged from 5 to 17 and Stress climbed from the mid 30s to 56. The single Tail peak of 17 came in the 09:00 UTC hour on August 31 during a European event/whipsaw window; dominant mode was mixed in 22 of the 24 hours, with event/whipsaw only at 09:00 and 10:00 UTC. From the US session onward Stress rose steadily as crude extended on the Larak Island exchange, the 10-year yield pushed to its highest level since January 2025 and September rate-hike odds firmed after the Jackson Hole address, while Tail stayed compressed between 9 and 13 because the price path itself remained two-sided. The overnight hours since the Monday cash close held that pattern, with Stress at 51-56 and Tail at 9-11.
outlookSummary: The base case over the next 24 hours is continued contained, two-sided trade with an elevated-Stress, low-Tail profile. Conditional risk concentrates in the narrow 13:30-15:00 UTC danger window around the US cash open and the simultaneous 14:00 UTC ISM Manufacturing PMI and JOLTS releases, where forecast Tail peaks at 18 and Stress at 66 with dominant mode projected as event/whipsaw - still inside the EA_ON band. Risk is then projected to decay through the US afternoon as event volatility unwinds, with a small power-hour uptick into the 20:00 UTC cash close, before easing to the low of the window overnight and firming slightly into the September 2 European pre-open ahead of ADP. Every forecast hour maps to EA_ON. The projection would be invalidated by observed persistent one-way structure, shallow or failed retracements, NQ holding near session extremes, or a fresh geopolitical discontinuity in the Strait of Hormuz.
